description: Report what changed on the items this API key watches, such as a new advisory for a package or a certificate about to expire, oldest first. A plain call continues where the last one stopped. Requires a Pro API key.

cursor.description: next_cursor of an earlier answer; reads after it and keeps the position

limit.description: Most events per call; a shorter page with has_more true is not the end; repeat=true answers the whole last batch

repeat.description: Answers the last batch again; cannot be combined with cursor

name: watchlist_events
title: Monitoring Events
